description: The dry-run row and the real send row are distinct ids that share one delivery hash.
why_it_exists: A dry run must never be mistaken for a send and must never overwrite one, while still being traceable to the same delivery decision. Separate id prefixes over a shared hash give both properties.
assertions: communication_id_dry ("COM-DRY-" + hash) differs from communication_id_send ("COM-" + hash)
both ids contain the same delivery_hash
dry_key is exactly send_key with a "|DRY" suffix
